verses.en: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.sm: Atua mo latou fili; o le manuia o e usiusitai i le Atua Oi talofa ia te oe o lē faatafuna atu, a e le faatafunaina oe; ua e faasaua, a e latou te le faasaua la te oe; a tuna e oe ona faatafuna atu, ona faatafunaina lea o oe; a uma ¿ou faasaua, ona latou faasaua lea ia te oe.

verses.en: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ia e alofa mai ia te i matou, ua matou faatalitali atu ia te oe; ia fai oe mo latou lima i taeao uma, o lo matou faaola foi i ona po o le puapuaga.

verses.en: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.sm: O le leo o le taalili na sosola ai le nuu; o lou tulai na faataapeapeina ai o nuu ese.

verses.en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.sm: E faaputuina la outou vete e pei ona aoaoina mea e le sé kasili; e pei ona fetaufetulia'i o sé akerise, e faapea foi ona fetaufetulia‘i i ai o tagata.

verses.en: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.sm: E silisili le ALII; aua o loo a6o o ia i luga; ua faatumuina e ia Siona i le faamasinoga ma le amiotonu.

verses.en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
verses.sm: O ia o le e tumau ai ou tausaga, o le tele o le faaolataga, o le poto ma le malamalama; o le mataʻu i le ALTI, o lana oloa lea.

verses.en: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.sm: Faauta, e alalaga o latou tagata totoa i fafo; e tagi lotulotu o le savali o le faaleleiga.

verses.en: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
verses.sm: Ua gaogao ala tele, e le toe ai se malaga; ua na tuumavaega, ua ia inosia aai, ua ia le manatu i tagata.

verses.en: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
verses.sm: © loo faanoanoa le laueleele, ua mamae; ua faamaina Lepanona, ua mamae; ua avea ma nuu lafulafua Sarona; ua malili lau laau o Vasana ma Karamelu.

verses.en: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai le ALII, Ou te tulai atu nei lava; e viia nei lava aʻu; e faasilisiliina nei au.

verses.en: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
verses.sm: E toto outou o tuna magumagu, tou te fananau mai o tagutugutu o saito; o lo outou mánava o le afi lava lea e “aina ai outou.

verses.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.sm: E avea foi le nuu e pei ona mu o umu panisina; e pei o laau tuitui ua salaina, e susunuina i latou i le afi.

verses.en: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.sm: Outou o e mamao, ia outou faalogologo mai i le mea ua ou faja; outou foi o e latalata mai, ia outou iloa loʻu mana.

verses.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.sm: O e agasala i Siona ua fefefe i latou; o e faalematau ua maua i latou i le mataʻu. O ai ea so tatou na te mafaia ona nofo i le afi mu tele? O ai ea so tatou na te mafaia ona nofo i le afi e faavavau?

verses.en: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
verses.sm: O le ua savali i le amiotonu, ma tautala i upu tonu; o le ua ‘ino‘ino i le oloa e maua i le faasaua, ua liaiina e ia ona lima ina neʻi tago i se taui, ua pupuni e ia ona taliga ina ne“ faalogo atu i pulega o fasiga, ua moe foi ona mata ina neʻi vaai atu i le leaga.

verses.en: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
verses.sm: E mau lava o ia i le mea maualuga, o ‘olo papa o lona malu lea; e foaiina ia te ia ana mea e fai, e tumau pea ia te ia le vai.

verses.en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
verses.sm: E maimoa ou mata i le tupu i lona matagofie; latou te vaavaai i nuu mamao.

verses.en: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
verses.sm: E manatunatu lou loto i le mea sa mataʻu ai. O ifea ea le tusiupu? O ifea ea le tali taulaga? O ifea ea le faitau ‘olo?

verses.en: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
verses.sm: E te le toe vaaia le nuu feai, o le nuu upu faigata e le mafai ona lagona; ua ese a latou gagana e le mafai ona iloa.

verses.en: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.sm: Vaai atu ia i Siona le aai o tatou faapotopotoga; e iloa lava e ou mata O Ierusalema le mea e nofo filemu ai, le fale ie e le tatalaina, e le toe liaiina lava sona fao, e le motusia lava sona maea e tasi.

verses.en: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.sm: Aua e ia te i tatou i lea mea o le ALII le silisili, e fai O ia ma vaitafe ma maga vai lautetele; e le alu i ai se vaa e fai foe, e le ui ane iai foi se vaa tele.

verses.en: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
verses.sm: Aua o le ALII o lo tatou faamasino ia, o le ALII o lo tatou fai tulafono, o le ALII o lo tatou tupu, o ia lava e faaola ia te i tatou.

verses.en: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
verses.sm: Ua mali ou maea, latou te le mafaia ona faamauina o le tulafana, latou te le mafai ona fai la; ona tufatufaina ai lea o le oloa o le vete tele; e vete lava e tagata pipili.

verses.en: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.sm: E Je fai mai foi se tasi ua mau ai, Ou te ta“; e faamagaloina agasala a le nuu e nonofo ai.
